item.tib: bla ma rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa las rgyud bskang pad+ma dkar po mu tig phreng ba mi pham mgon po
item.coloph: ces pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la thugs dam rgyud nas bskang (skong) ba rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pa nyid kyis mdzad pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang las (nas)/ phran gyis 'khyor gong blang nas gar bsgyar ba'i/ ma 'ongs thos chung blo rmong (rmongs) rnams la thig pa re tsam phog pa'i skom pa'i gdung ba sel phyir/ mi pham mgon po bdag gis brtsoms (brtsams) pas 'gal 'khrul song na/ bla na ma mchis pa'i lha/ rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng dang / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ dge mchis gang zag rnams gdung ba sel zhing / bstan pa'i dpal rgyan du gyur cig/
